meta.name: Challenge Accepted
meta.description:
Challenge Accepted follows Michelle Khare as she attempts the world's most difficult lifestyles, stunts, and professions.

Shows: I Trained Like Miss USA For 60 Days, I Tried Defending A Murder Trial, I Competed In A Beauty Pageant For The First Time, I Trained Like An Olympic Figure Skater, I Tried Santa School
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
